commitMessage:
Reseller privacy: customers' devices show status and subscription only

Resellers keep full access to their stock devices (installation tests)
but, for devices owned by one of their customers, no longer see location,
trip history, replay, reports, commands, position details or the share
button. The device list shows status and subscription with a note; the
map and auto-zoom skip those devices; report and replay device pickers
leave them out ('all' expands to the allowed devices, groups are hidden)
and no request is made while the list is loading, so the server is never
asked for 'all devices'. Command and position pages redirect to the map.

Enforced in the web app only: the server still gives resellers access to
devices linked to them. Docs updated (roles, limits, change history).
